messages:
Monica (CSM): Heads-up — Acme POS (midmarket) hit activation fallthrough. Onboarded 3 weeks ago, first API calls stopped after day 4. No responses to onboarding emails.
Eli (CS Ops): Ack. Do we have logs on their auth errors or quota drops?
Monica (CSM): I looked — no auth failures. Most recent calls are 4xx from our side due to malformed webhook payloads. Could be a connector mismatch.
Jordan (AE): I pinged their CTO last week, got radio silence. I can try a quick personal nudge today.
Sara (Support): I can pull the last 14 days of request traces and redact PII, then paste the common error lines. Will do in 30m.
Monica (CSM): Thanks. Thinking we should: 1) 48‑hour targeted nudge cadence (Jordan) 2) in‑product subtle checklist nudge via onboarding banner (Eli) 3) offer 1:1 enablement session + quick checklist 4) downgrade-safety net if they ask to downgrade.
Jordan (AE): For the nudge copy, suggestion: "Hey — saw your onboarding stalled. Quick 20min sync to unblock the connector? Free session from our onboarding team." Keep it low friction. :phone:
Monica (CSM): Love it. Add an explicit CTA to schedule via my calendar link. Also include a small trial credit to re-run integration tests.
Sara (Support): Paste from traces: ```
ERROR 400 malformed_json at /events webhook: missing field 'source'
ERROR 422 unsupported_event_type: 'purchase_refund'
``` Might be their integration library is older.
Eli (CS Ops): We can ship a short diagnostic checklist they can run locally: 1) verify webhook schema v2 2) rotate webhook signing key 3) validate payload using our validator: `curl -X POST https://validator.redwood.ai/check -d @sample.json`
Monica (CSM): Can someone draft the micro-play we use for fallthroughs? Need copy for nudge, support diagnostic steps, an enablement slot template, and the downgrade grace messaging. Keep it <2 steps for customer-facing.
Jordan (AE): I'll draft the nudge and follow-up cadence. Proposed cadence: Day 0: personal email + calendar link; Day 3: in-app banner + short how-to; Day 7: offer enablement session; Day 10: grace downgrade offer with retention credits + docs link.
Monica (CSM): Good. For downgrade messaging, keep it empathetic: "We understand needs change — here's a safe downgrade path that keeps your data and lets you re-up without friction." Include reactivation playbook link.
Sara (Support): I'll prepare the sanitized traces and attach them to the ticket. Also add a note to the account that support has suggested updating client lib to v1.4.2.
Eli (CS Ops): I'll queue a small in‑product banner draft and wire the validator endpoint to the onboarding banner button. Need approval on the copy.
Monica (CSM): Action items: Jordan — nudge copy + send today; Sara — traces + ticket update; Eli — banner draft + validator hook; Jordan/Monica — 1:1 enablement slot if they accept. I'll follow-up in 48h.
Jordan (AE): On it. I'll post the nudge copy here for quick sign-off before sending.
cs-bot: Reminder: create retention case in CS tracker for ACME-POS with priority = medium and tag = "activation-fallthrough".
Monica (CSM): Added note: capture feedback prompt during enablement: "What blocked you most during setup? (select one)" with options: docs, webhook schema, auth, other. We'll use that to feed product gaps.
Eli (CS Ops): If they accept enablement, propose we run a short eval: run sample workload of 1000 calls and compare latency/cost baseline => helps us recommend batching/quantization if needed.
Monica (CSM): Perfect. If no reply by day 4, escalate to AE + Customer Success Manager for a sync. If still no reply by day 10, trigger downgrade-prep messaging but hold off actual downgrade until we confirm.
Jordan (AE): Will send nudge now. Posting draft below for sign-off: "Hi — Monica here from Redwood. Noticed your integration stopped after initial tests. Can we do a quick 20m call to walk through webhook schema + run a validator? Here's my calendar: <link>. — Jordan"
Monica (CSM): Sign-off. Send. :thumbsup:
Sara (Support): Ticket updated with traces and next steps. Ticket #CS-5239.
Eli (CS Ops): Banner draft: "Need help finishing setup? Run our validator or book a 15m session." Button -> `Run validator` / `Book 15m`
Monica (CSM): Great thread — will loop back after Jordan's outreach. Capture any customer feedback in the ticket and tag product if schema comes up repeatedly.
Jordan (AE): Sent nudge. Will update thread if they reply.
Monica (CSM): Thanks team. End of thread for now.
